rule: When the same hard mutation class (ledger, topo) fails twice with reason=max_steps at different budgets, do not raise steps again. Enqueue a diagnosis job: single mutation + --trace + --read-first. The goal is tool-sequence evidence, not more budget. After the trace lands, form a new hypothesis (never-read, wrong file, shallow rewrite, etc.) and test that hypothesis with the smallest experiment.
